instructions: This is a conversation about a peer-to-peer goods exchange. `context` is the preceding exchange and `target` is the final message. `target` is written by the other participant, not the last speaker in `context`. How does the author of `target` respond to the proposal or request the other person made just before?

options.label: accept
options.description: Accepts the preceding proposal or request.

options.label: reject
options.description: Declines the preceding proposal or request, including indirect refusals.

options.label: question
options.description: Asks for confirmation or more information before deciding.

options.label: other
options.description: None of the above, e.g. deferring, changing the topic, or only a greeting.
